identity.authentication: IDs and PID/UID are recorded, but do not attest distinct human/session identity. Same-UID host actors remain trusted.

provenance.provenance_limit: Original authorship of inherited untracked files not independently established; current owner audited and adopted them after stale-claim takeover

purpose: Local CPU-only unprivileged candidate sandbox; never promote or modify champion

quotas.disk_mb: RLIMIT_FSIZE per file 1..1024 plus periodic aggregate output scan
quotas.limitation: Not cgroup aggregate caps: forked processes or burst writes could temporarily exceed total CPU, memory, disk or process limits. No process count cap.

read_only.optional_inputs: name:absolute path:sha256; integrity only, NOT independent review authorization
read_only.source: absolute no-symlink file, hashed on creation and rechecked before launch

roles.IMPLEMENTER: Owns source/test changes; cannot approve itself
roles.TRAINER: Run only a version-pinned source in its own sandbox output root
roles.VERIFIER: Separate pulled reviewer with explicit independent receipt; no mount into trainer

security_limits: No elevated privileges or systemd service
Source and extra-input SHA alone do NOT establish independent dataset approval; default test mounts zero extra datasets
Caller can request arbitrary --input path; use only operator-approved datasets; enforce an approval allowlist in NC-045 before untrusted data ingestion
Same-UID host actor can edit parent files; this is not host-level identity authorization
No training of a new neural successor and no promotion claim in NC-044; this is a deterministic isolation canary

state.interruption: orphan/unverified checkpoint fails closed; automatic crash recovery is not claimed
state.last_report: last_execution.json with checkpoint hash, exit status and timing
state.restart: clean checkpoint replay tested for equivalence with uninterrupted run
state.resume: checkpoint hash verification and worker exits 0 if successful
state.rollback: Original champion is never written or promoted; rollback is preserving its pinned bytes, not restoring a modified default
state.run_manifest: run.json (hashes, quotas, creator and worker IDs)

write_boundary.mode: bubblewrap read-only host /usr and pinned inputs; /output only writable bind; unshared network/PID
